items.exampleEn: The smell of this soup is reminiscent of my grandmother's kitchen.
items.exampleZh: 這碗湯的味道讓我想起奶奶的廚房。

items.exampleEn: The teacher scrutinized our faces to see who had laughed.
items.exampleZh: 老師仔細端詳我們的臉，想看出是誰笑了。

items.exampleEn: Without any context, these numbers are meaningless.
items.exampleZh: 沒有任何背景說明，這些數字毫無意義。

items.exampleEn: Freedom is an abstraction that is hard to define.
items.exampleZh: 自由是一個很難定義的抽象概念。

items.exampleEn: Good chess players rely on intuition as well as logic.
items.exampleZh: 優秀的西洋棋手既靠邏輯，也靠直覺。

items.exampleEn: She is a woman of great intellect and humor.
items.exampleZh: 她是一位才智過人又風趣的女士。

items.exampleEn: Children have an intuitive sense of what is fair.
items.exampleZh: 孩子天生就有一種直覺的公平感。

items.exampleEn: The judges concurred that her dance was the best.
items.exampleZh: 評審們一致認為她的舞蹈最好。

items.sentenceEn: The design of this phone is simple and intuitive.
items.sentenceZh: 這支手機的設計簡單又直觀。

items.audioEn: Her intuition told her that something was wrong, so she called home.
items.audioZh: 她的直覺告訴她有點不對勁，所以她打了電話回家。
options: She sensed a problem at home.
She was going to be late.

items.sentenceEn: The museum's new building is reminiscent of a giant ship.
items.sentenceZh: 博物館的新建築讓人聯想到一艘巨大的船。

items.sentenceEn: Most experts concur with the findings of the report.
items.sentenceZh: 大多數專家都同意這份報告的結果。

items.stemEn: Long meetings without a clear goal often feel ____.
items.stemZh: 沒有明確目標的冗長會議，常常讓人覺得沒有意義。

items.stemEn: Inspectors will ____ every document before the company receives the money.
items.stemZh: 公司拿到這筆錢之前，檢查員會仔細審核每一份文件。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, I visited an exhibition of modern paintings. Many of the works were pure abstraction: blocks of color with no people or objects. At first, they seemed almost meaningless to me. Then a guide explained that the artist did not plan her paintings with her intellect alone; she trusted her intuition and painted quickly. One large blue painting, the guide said, was reminiscent of the sea near the artist's childhood home. The exhibition also showed the artist's versatility, with photos and small sculptures. After that, I scrutinized each painting more slowly. My friend, who is a painter, concurs that this kind of art needs patience.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我去看了一場現代繪畫展。許多作品是純粹的抽象畫：只有一塊塊色彩，沒有人物也沒有物體。一開始，這些畫對我來說幾乎毫無意義。後來導覽員解釋，這位畫家不只靠理智來規劃畫作，她相信自己的直覺，畫得很快。導覽員說，其中一幅藍色大畫，讓人想起畫家童年老家附近的大海。展覽也呈現了畫家的多才多藝，有攝影作品和小型雕塑。之後，我放慢腳步，仔細看每一幅畫。我那位當畫家的朋友也認為，這類藝術需要耐心。

questions.questionZh: 導覽員說這位畫家怎麼作畫？
那幅藍色大畫讓人想起什麼？

items.promptZh: 我同意你對這份報告的看法。
referenceEn: I concur with your view of this report.
I concur with your opinion on the report.
rubricZh: concur with＋人或看法表示「同意」（例如 concur with your view 等）

items.promptZh: 選擇室友時，我常常相信自己的直覺。
referenceEn: When I choose a roommate, I often trust my intuition.
I often follow my intuition when choosing a roommate.
rubricZh: 「相信直覺」可寫，例如 trust my intuition、follow my intuition、rely on my intuition 等
「常常」可寫，例如 often、usually，位置有彈性

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項 uncharacteristic、complementary 跨課重複；q14 的 amplification、conscientiously 亦同，且詞性不合動詞位置，一眼可排除。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: q13 改為 profound、credible（同單元，「會議讓人覺得深刻／可信」不通），保留 intuitive；q14 改為同單元及物動詞 reassure、allege（放得進空格但語意不通）與 abstraction

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：concur with＋人或看法表示「同意」（例如 concur with your view 等）／「看法」可寫，例如 view、opinion 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：intuition 表示「直覺」（例如 follow my intuition、my intuition told me… 等）／時態配合內容（例如 followed、told 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（intuition）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u06-l04-q17；目標字沿用 intuition
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「選擇室友時，我常常相信自己的直覺。」、hintWords ["intuition"]、referenceEn ["When I choose a roommate, I often trust my intuition.","I often follow my intuition when choosing a roommate."]、rubricZh ["「相信直覺」可寫，例如 trust my intuition、follow my intuition、rely on my intuition 等","「常常」可寫，例如 often、usually，位置有彈性"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 intuition 造一個句子，說說你憑直覺做決定的一次經驗。」、referenceEn ["I followed my intuition and took the job in Taipei.","My intuition told me not to buy that used car, and I was right."]）
